function.description: Analyzes the DNA sequence based on a reference sequence and return any potential mutations. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

The function returns any potential mutations. We need to call it with appropriate arguments. The function signature: analyze_dna_sequence({sequence, reference_sequence, mutation_type?}). The default is insertion. So for insertion we can omit mutation_type or set to "insertion". For deletion and substitution we set accordingly.
